name: Follow Delivery
description: Suburban home front porch at midday. Person approaches porch where a paper bag is sitting by the door. The scene shows approach to an unattended item but does not capture a delivery driver or the 'following delivery' pattern described.

generation.cosmos_prompt: Suburban home front porch at midday, viewed from an elevated vantage point near the door. Seconds after a delivery driver leaves frame, a different person quickly approaches, grabs the just-delivered package, and hurries away. Stalking delivery pattern. Static elevated viewpoint, clear daytime footage. Real-time speed, natural fluid motion at 1x playback rate.
